stories.title: New research shows how 'hot electrons' can reshape metals in billionths of a second
stories.desc: Researchers at The University of Manchester have revealed how intense electronic excitation can trigger rapid structural changes in metals—without heating the atomic lattice—offering new insight into ultrafast materials behavior.

stories.title: Scientists demonstrate transition between strong and weak coupling regimes in a polariton microcavity
stories.desc: Researchers from Skoltech, together with colleagues from the N.D. Zelinsky Institute of Organic Chemistry and Westlake University, have experimentally demonstrated how the operating regime of a polariton laser changes with a gradual increase in cavity thickness.

stories.title: Smoke Blankets Oregon

stories.title: Enhancing Induced Seismicity: A New Window into Earthquake Physics
stories.desc: Controlled multi-day hydraulic stimulation experiments in the BedrettoLab aim to generate seismicity in order improve the understanding for rupture processes of natural and induced earthquakes.
